built.D1: intake-evidence-worker.ts: a table source whose newest raw streaming job stored windows (latestTableJobTx, the lookup TableRowsService.page now calls) is read window by window with readTableWindowTx; windowAssertions (intake-evidence.ts) gives each row's key cell as tableAssertions does; the locator cites the source row plus an optional window field (window index, record number, byte range, SHA-256 of that range); rawJobId is the raw streaming job, rawInputSha256 its input, rawResultSha256 the stored window's SHA-256 and acceptedFence the window's fence. A whole-file row omits the field and keeps its locator unchanged
built.D2: closed only when the raw job is completed (or completed_with_rejections), no window failed and rows read equal the job's records; a running, queued, failed or stale raw job gives partial with read and eligible/keyless over the rows read, unread null, failed null unless a window failed; a stored window that does not read back (TABLE_WINDOW_INTEGRITY or a shape error) counts its records as failed
built.D3: closeEvidence unchanged; a partial reading proposes only keys a building holds, because the candidate contract refuses no_match on unread coverage (closeEvidence would otherwise throw and stop the reading)
built.D4: one window held at a time; at most 50,000 key cells per reading (WINDOW_ASSERTIONS, five full windows); windows past the bound stay unread and the coverage stays partial

register.cut: readTabularWindows (G13) and windowRows give one stored window of 753 records; regrouped test_only into 8 windows of 100 records, each window hash the SHA-256 of exactly its byte range

finishedRawJob.sameAsWholeRead: for 1 window and for 8 windows: identical candidate ids, outcomes, conflict groups, source rows and row hashes; each cited byte range hashes to its stated SHA-256 and holds the key literal

runningRawJob.note: no no_match candidate; only keys a building holds are proposed. A failed raw job gives the same coverage

failedWindow.note: test_only: window 1 stored with its rows reversed fails its own record check and counts as failed

results.noStoredWindow: the windowed reading returns nothing and the existing path applies (a table over 16 MiB with no window stays partial, read 0)

notBuilt: a reading of a running raw job is not queued again when the raw job finishes; the source stays partial until the next reading under the profile
no runtime run: no database or Docker; the worker's windowed reading runs on the real register through a fake client that answers its statements
seamsOutsideOwnedPaths: packages/server/src/modules/usp/ingestion/table-windows.ts: one export, latestTableJobTx, the raw job lookup TableRowsService.page used inline; page now calls it
